description: Land Title Settlement Dept. - Dediyawala, Kalutara D/S Division, Kalutara District (25/0291)
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters, including declarations of title determination for specific land parcels, ownership details, and land registration under the Registration of Title Act. It contains detailed schedules with land parcel numbers, owner information, extent of land, encumbrances, and other property-related particulars, which clearly falls under the Land Gazettes classification (Type 4).
